title: Broadcast Education and Development Scholarship
summary: Professional-development assistance for eligible employees of Colorado radio and television stations.
eligibility: Full-time employees of CBA member stations who have worked at the station for at least six months and meet Colorado residency requirements.

title: Iowa Broadcast News Association Scholarships
summary: Grant Price Scholarship and Dick Petrik Outstanding Student Award for promising electronic-media journalists.
eligibility: Students in good standing at eligible two- or four-year Iowa colleges, with class-standing and work-sample requirements varying by award.

title: Kentucky Broadcasters Association Scholarships
summary: Competitive scholarships for students studying broadcasting or communications at Kentucky colleges and universities.
eligibility: Students majoring in broadcasting or communications at a Kentucky college or university; rising juniors receive priority consideration.

title: Maine Association of Broadcasters Scholarships
summary: Scholarship assistance for students pursuing journalism, broadcasting, media arts and digital studies.
eligibility: Students entering postsecondary education in an eligible media-related field; consult the current application for complete requirements.

title: Idaho State Broadcasters Association Academic Scholarships
summary: Academic scholarship program encouraging Idaho students who are considering careers in broadcasting.
eligibility: Students meeting the Idaho State Broadcasters Association's current academic scholarship requirements.

title: James Wychor Scholarship
summary: Scholarship designed to support the next generation of Minnesota broadcasting professionals.
eligibility: Minnesota high school seniors planning study in mass communications, marketing, engineering, production, editing or another broadcast-related field.

title: Missouri Broadcasters Association Foundation Scholarships
summary: Foundation scholarships assisting Missouri students preparing for careers in broadcasting and digital media.
eligibility: Missouri students studying or preparing to study broadcasting or digital media; individual scholarship requirements may vary.

title: Mississippi Association of Broadcasters Scholarships
summary: Scholarships for students enrolled in media-related educational programs at Mississippi institutions.
eligibility: Students meeting current residency, enrollment, broadcast-curriculum and application requirements established by the association.

title: OAB Kids Scholarship
summary: Annual scholarship for a child of a full-time employee of an Ohio Association of Broadcasters member station.
eligibility: Graduating students whose parent is a full-time employee of an eligible OAB member radio or television station.

title: Oklahoma Association of Broadcasters Scholarships and Assistance
provider: Oklahoma Association of Broadcasters Education Foundation
award: Scholarships and student assistance awards vary
summary: Scholarships and financial-assistance programs supporting students preparing for Oklahoma broadcast careers.
eligibility: Eligibility varies by program and generally requires broadcast study at an Oklahoma college or university.

title: Texas Broadcast Education Foundation Scholarships
summary: Scholarships for Texas college students preparing for careers in broadcast journalism, production and engineering.
eligibility: Students enrolled in eligible broadcast programs at Texas colleges and universities; consult the current TAB application.

title: TAWA Journalism and Public Relations Scholarships
summary: Two journalism scholarships and one public-relations scholarship for students interested in automotive media careers.
eligibility: Juniors at four-year institutions who intend to pursue careers in journalism or public relations and meet the association's requirements.

title: Alabama Broadcasters Association Endowed Scholarship at ASU
provider: Alabama Broadcasters Association and Alabama State University
summary: Endowed scholarship supporting Alabama State University students studying broadcast communications.
eligibility: Eligible Alabama State University communications majors, generally juniors or seniors meeting current GPA and program requirements.

title: Arizona Broadcasters Association Scholarship
provider: Arizona Broadcasters Association and ASU Foundation
institution: Arizona State University Walter Cronkite School
summary: Scholarship support for students preparing for broadcasting careers at ASU's Walter Cronkite School.
eligibility: Eligible Walter Cronkite School students selected under current ASU scholarship requirements.

title: Arkansas Broadcasters Association Scholarship Fund
provider: Arkansas Broadcasters Association and University of Arkansas
summary: Scholarship for University of Arkansas journalism majors interested in radio and television.
eligibility: Eligible University of Arkansas journalism majors demonstrating interest in broadcasting, financial need, character and scholarship.

title: A-Mark Journalism Scholarships and Student Awards
summary: Undergraduate and graduate journalism scholarships plus awards for community-college student journalists.
eligibility: Students at participating institutions; each college or university administers and selects recipients under its own process.
